📖 How to use

  1. Type text or choose a file to hash.
  2. Click "Generate hashes".
  3. Copy any digest with its copy button.
  4. Compare digests to verify file integrity or checksums.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the hashes computed?

SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 use your browser's built-in WebCrypto engine. MD5 and SHA-1 are computed with audited pure-JavaScript implementations included on this page.

Are MD5 and SHA-1 safe to use?

MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use (collisions can be forged). They are offered only for checksums and compatibility — use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for security.

Is my file uploaded anywhere?

No. Files are read into memory and hashed locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
